summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing that it received conditional approval to list its common shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange and graduate from the TSX Venture Exchange. The filing details a corporate milestone but does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting (other than the scheduled TSXV delisting concomitant with the TSX listing), issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The listing is subject to final TSX approval by September 14, 2026, with no change in CUSIP or shareholder action required. This is a routine exchange graduation filing that does not constitute a special situation; the delisting from TSXV is a mechanical consequence of the TSX listing, not an event-driven special situation.
